summary_source: [지디넷코리아]국가유산청(청장 허민)은 전국 16개 광역 시·도 대상으로 공모한 ‘2027년 지역 국가유산 교육 사업’의 최종 25개 사업을 선정했다고 10일 밝혔다. 지역 국가유산교육 활성화 사업은 지역의 유치원, 초·중·고 학생들을 대상으로 학교 교실을 직접 방문하는 학교교육과 지역주민, 방과 후 청소년, 취약계층 등을 위한 사회교육을 포괄하는 교육지원 사업이다. 특히 이 사업은 전문 강사들이 진행하는 강의와 토의, 역사유적 등 국가유산 현장교육, 무형유산·국가유산 교구재와 디지털 콘텐츠, 인공지능(AI) 등을 활용한 체험교육 등 지역주민과 학생들이 지역의 국가유산의 가치와 의미를 쉽게 배우고 향유할 수 있도록 다양한 프로그램으로 운영된다.이번 사업 공모에는 총 84개의 사업이 접수됐으며, 전문가 심사를 거쳐 25개 사업이 최종 선정됐다. 먼저 미래기술(인공지능(AI)·디지털) 융합 교육을 주제로 한 ▲‘AI와 함께하는 개운포 경상좌수영성 디지털 탐구교실’(울산 남구) ▲‘AI·생명공학으로 배우는 보은 국가유산 미래학교’(충북 보은군)가 있다. 또 지역 사회 연계 및 진로 탐색 교육을 주제로 공모한 ▲‘광산, 국가유산 꽃이 피다’(광주 광산구) ▲‘특명…

title_en: National Heritage Administration selects 25 projects for ‘2027 Regional National Heritage Education Project’
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] The National Heritage Administration (Director Heo Min) announced on the 10th that it had selected the final 25 projects for the ‘2027 Regional National Heritage Education Project’, which was open to 16 metropolitan cities and provinces across the country. summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]カカオゲームズ（共同代表キム・テファン、イシウ）は、京畿道城南市に位置する城南総合運動場野外バスケットボール場で社会貢献（CSR）キャンペーン「訪れるフレンズゲームランド」秋のゲーム運動会を行ったと10日、児童および青少年に地域代表産業であるゲーム・ITコンテンツ体験機会を提供するために設けられた。カカオゲームズは去る5月、城南市「地球村ふれあいまつり」に続き、今年2度目に城南市と連携して「訪れるフレンズゲームランド」を運営、地域社会児童・青少年のゲームアクセシビリティ向上に寄与している。 カカオゲームズはイベント現場に▲障害認識向上ゾーン（車椅子スポーツゲーム） ▲IT教育ゾーン（ドローン操縦ゲーム、ロボットサッカーゲーム） ▲プレイゾーン（ウォータータトゥー、ボールプール場、フォトゾーン）など多彩な体験空間を設けた。特にIT教育ゾーンにドローンやロボットなどを活用した新規コンテンツを導入し、誘導した。ドローンとロボットを直接操縦し、与えられた問題を解決し、創造性、問題解決力、デジタル能力を自然に育てることができるように図ったというのが会社側の説…
title_en: Kakao Games holds social contribution campaign ‘Visiting Friends Game Land’ fall game sports day
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Kakao Games (Co-CEOs Kim Tae-hwan and Lee Si-woo) announced on the 10th that it held the fall game sports day for its social contribution (CSR) campaign ‘Visiting Friends Game Land’ at the outdoor basketball court at Seongnam Sports Complex located in Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do. This event, held yesterday (9th), was designed to provide children and teenagers at local children's centers within Seongnam-si with the opportunity to experience games and IT content, which are representative industries of the region. Following the Seongnam City ‘Global Harmony Festival’ in May, Kakao Games is contributing to improving game accessibility for children and youth in the local community by operating ‘Visiting Friends Game Land’ in conjunction with Seongnam City for the second time this year. Kakao Games has ▲Kakao Games Zone (4D VR Game Bus, 4D VR Sports) at the event site ▲Disabled Awareness Zone (Wheelchair Sports Game) A variety of experiential spaces were prepared, including ▲IT education zone (drone control game, robot soccer game) ▲play zone (water tattoo, ball pool, photo zone). In particular, new content using drones and robots was introduced in the IT education zone to encourage children and teenagers to enjoy science and technology through games. The company explains that it aims to naturally develop creativity, problem-solving skills, and digital capabilities by directly controlling drones and robots and solving given problems.

title_en: Notification of the result of the motif objection is imminent, will it affect the final match of Dokpamo?
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Notification of the results of the appeal of Motif Technologies, which was eliminated in the second evaluation of the 'Independent AI Foundation Model (Dokpamo)' project, which is called the national artificial intelligence (AI) selection competition, is imminent. Attention is focused on whether the results of this deliberation will affect the third round method and evaluation system to determine the final two teams early next year. According to the industry on the 10th, it was confirmed that the results of the Ministry of Science and ICT's objection deliberation had not been delivered to Motif Technologies as of this morning. As the Ministry of Science and ICT has announced its policy to process objections within 15 days from the date of receipt, the results are expected to be notified soon. The actual objection is known to have been received on the 25th of last month. It was on the 27th, two days later, that Motif Technologies officially disclosed the facts of the objection and detailed demands. title_en: Netmarble Cultural Foundation successfully concludes ‘2026 National Disabled Students e-Festival’
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Netmarble Cultural Foundation (Chairman Bang Jun-hyuk) announced on the 10th that it had successfully completed the ‘2026 National Disabled Students e-Festival’, hosted with the National Institute of Special Education and Korea Creative Content Agency and sponsored by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism. The ‘2026 National Disabled Students e-Festival’ was held for two days on the 8th and 9th. From May to July, about 1,600 participants, including students, teachers, and parents from special schools across the country, selected through local preliminaries in which about 3,000 students participated from across the country, participated and competed in good faith. The competition consisted of a total of 29 events, including 11 e-sports events (MaguMagu Remastered, Everyone's Marble, etc.) and 18 information competitions, and a total of 29 winning teams in each event were selected. They were honored with awards such as the Minister of Education Award and the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Award. In particular, students Kim Ha-yul and Lee Dong-woo from Jumong School won ‘Magu Magu Remaster’, and students Choi Eun-yu and Choi Jeong-woo from Yeongdong Elementary School in Chungcheongbuk-do won ‘Everyone’s Marble’. Students Ha-yul Kim and Lee Dong-woo, who participated in the Magu Magu Remastered event and won, said, “I took the challenge last year, but I practiced more this year and was happy to overcome the tension and win.” In addition, the results of the information contest and other events will be released later on the contest website. title_en: Stealing a car with a “hula hoop”? Suspected man suspected of being misused for "relay attack" equipment, first in the nation, arrested again
summary_en: By September 9th, Saitama Prefectural Police had re-arrested two suspects, Jinichi Shukuhara (26) and Mirado Saito (28), both unemployed and of no fixed address, on suspicion of stealing a car from someone else's property. title_source: Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear Solid Spiritual Successor Physint Will Now Be Published by Xbox Instead of Sony
summary_source: Renowned video game director Hideo Kojima's upcoming project Physint, which could fairly be described as a spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid, will now be published by Xbox instead of Sony, Microsoft announced today.
